meta.name: Koray SEO Semantics — Technique Database
meta.scope: Public white papers + theoretical guides only; not paywalled course videos
meta.source_context_lock: Feeling Yachty is a private yacht charter / experiences brand (Miami, Panama, and served destinations) — not a generic travel magazine.
operator_locks: Homepage H1 Miami Yacht Rental stays; home is the Miami ranker
Every page and every city ranks on its own — do not 301 Miami hubs together
Miami vs Panama phones intentional — do not unify
Hub / listing pricing out of scope

pillars.name: Topical Authority
pillars.formula_public: ((Historical Data × Topical Coverage) ÷ Cost of Retrieval) × Right Visual Annotations
pillars.summary: Positive ranking state when a source covers connected queries/intents with accurate, unique, expert information — not when it merely has a blog.
pillars.fy_use: Earn authority for private yacht charter in Miami/Panama by completing the topical map, not by random tip posts.

pillars.name: Source Context
pillars.summary: Website perspective + monetization purpose that defines how every entity is framed.
pillars.fy_use: Every page must answer as a charter operator (bookings, inclusions, routes, capacity) — not as a travel magazine.

pillars.name: Brand Identity (Semantic)
pillars.summary: Purpose + attributes (founder, NAP, expertise, 3rd-party definitions) that must cohere with source context.
pillars.fy_use: Consistent Feeling Yachty NAP, review counts, Miami vs Panama identity, Brand SERP ownership.

pillars.name: Contextual Bridges
pillars.summary: Phrase/concept links between side-topics that keep internal links inside compatible query templates.
pillars.fy_use: Tips → money pages; occasions → vessel classes; Panama routes → Panama hub — never orphaned posts.

pillars.name: Topical Map / Semantic Content Network
pillars.summary: Planned graph of documents from query–document–intent templates with core vs outer vs reject layers.
pillars.fy_use: Core = charter money + yacht types + occasions; Outer = planning guides with bridges; Reject = thin AI / wrong city / test junk.

pillars.name: Entity–Attribute–Value (EAV)
pillars.summary: Make entities, attributes, and values explicit so neural matching can map incomplete queries to documents.
pillars.fy_use: Yacht: capacity, length, amenities, departure, duration, inclusions. Destination: marina, route, landmarks, season.

pillars.name: Cost of Retrieval
pillars.summary: Cost to crawl, render, evaluate, index, and serve a document relative to its value.
pillars.fy_use: noindex test/cart/checkout; prune thin tips; one owner per query cluster; fix broken/orphan vessel links.

pillars.name: Historical Data
pillars.summary: Accumulated satisfaction, consistency, and crawl/behavior evidence over time.
pillars.fy_use: Steady map completion + updates beat bursty off-map publishing.

pillars.name: Algorithmic Authorship
pillars.summary: Rule-based writing: one macro context, question headings, extractive answers, short dependency trees, SERP-matched formats.
pillars.fy_use: H2 as user questions; ~40-word direct answers; tables/lists for capacity/pricing process; no repeated facts.

techniques.name: Lock source context before writing
steps: Write one paragraph defining monetization + purpose
Reject topics that conflict with primary focus
Frame every entity definition from the charter-operator angle
techniques.fy_application: All briefs open with: private yacht charter / experiences brand for served cities.

techniques.name: Build topical map (core / outer / reject)
steps: Inventory entity types (destinations, yacht classes, occasions, durations, amenities)
Draft attributes per entity type
Assign query templates → planned URLs
Mark core vs outer vs reject
List centroids, gaps, and bridges
Publish priority queue
techniques.fy_application: Miami + Panama maps with separate city ownership; no merging hubs.

techniques.name: Query-cluster ownership registry
steps: Cluster queries by intent (not single keywords)
Assign one owner URL per cluster
List supporting URLs with bridge roles
Stop new pages that compete with the owner
Point internal links to the owner
techniques.fy_application: Use audits OWNERSHIP sheet (miami-vessel 134 competitors, etc.). Approve owners without 301-merging hubs.

techniques.name: Prune indexed junk (lower cost of retrieval)
steps: Find test, cart, checkout, Elementor leftovers in sitemap
noindex + remove from sitemap
Draft/trash in WordPress

techniques.name: Wrong-entity H1/slug alignment
steps: Scrape H1 vs URL vs body entities
Rewrite H1/slug so the page’s primary entity matches its ranking job
Keep each city page ranking for its own city
techniques.fy_application: CHG-007: FTL≠North Miami, destinations≠list-your-boat, panama-sales≠Miami rental, typo slugs.

techniques.name: EAV completeness on money + vessel pages
steps: List key attributes for the entity set
Ensure each attribute has an explicit value in prose/table
Order attributes by prominence to charter shopping
Make triples question-ready
techniques.fy_application: Vessel pages: capacity, length band, crew, amenities, ideal occasions, departure options, inclusions/exclusions.

techniques.name: Heading vectors + extractive answers
steps: H1 = primary commercial/macro intent
H2s as distinct user questions
First ~40 words under H2 = direct answer
No repeated facts across sections
Match format to SERP (list/table/definition/FAQ)
techniques.fy_application: Homepage FAQ already question-shaped — tighten extractive answers; replicate on occasion hubs.

techniques.name: Contextual bridge internal linking
steps: Write bridge sentence sharing entities/predicates
Max ~1 contextual link per heading section
Anchor text must appear on target page
Prefer I-node in-content links over footer spam
Side-topic links from supplementary content only
techniques.fy_application: Bachelor tips → miami-yacht-party; capacity guides → vessel owner; Panama tips → /panama-yacht-rentals/.

techniques.name: Expand map via entities/attributes/depth/gaps
steps: More entities of same type (yacht classes / served destinations only)
More attributes of existing entities
Deepen context with consistent definitions
Close gaps between centroids with bridges — not random posts
techniques.fy_application: Fill corporate/ash-scattering/route depth where money pages already signal demand; do not invent cities FY does not serve.

techniques.name: Tips quality gate (source-context filter)
steps: Keep tips that help a city/page rank with charter predicates
Prune TEST and thin automation posts
Deduplicate near-identical cost/theme posts into one owner + supports
techniques.fy_application: CHG-009 + bachelorette cost URL duplicates under /miami-yacht-tips/.

techniques.name: Brand SERP + entity identity hardening
steps: Consistent NAP + about facts across site/GBP
Single review-count source of truth
Corroborate on 3rd-party platforms
Suppress contradictory definitions
techniques.fy_application: CHG-011 review shortcode; keep city phones separate per OP-002.

techniques.name: Un-collapse aliased money URLs
steps: Detect URLs that resolve to another template
Either unique content for own ranking job or accept as alias and stop linking as owners

techniques.name: Folder/path city integrity
steps: URL path city must match page entity city
Move misfiled vessels/services

techniques.name: ES twin inherits EN owner
steps: Spanish URL follows English query-cluster owner
Do not merge ES Panama into ES Miami home
Maintain hreflang pairs

techniques.name: Unique information gain
steps: Answer questions competitors miss
Use real ops knowledge only
Mark [FACT NEEDED] instead of inventing prices/fleet
techniques.fy_application: Real itineraries, inclusions transparency, marina logistics, capacity guidance.

techniques.name: Historical data cadence
steps: Publish/update on map schedule
Measure post-publish (impressions, query ownership, CTR)
Revise networks after initial ranking
techniques.fy_application: Daily Koray briefs + weekly Learning log; no off-map AI spam bursts.

format: One primary idea (technique id + FY action)
